title: AgentEngineerSkillPackage
description: Package shape for one skill in the collection. Each skill is a leaf folder under skills/<family>/: SKILL.md (contract), schema.json (run fields), templates/*.md (the only allowed write-up). The skill id matches the leaf folder. The skill must be runnable alone via Use skill: <id>.

id.description: Stable skill id. Must match the leaf folder name under skills/<family>/ (feature-builder or mvp-builder). New skills are additive; do not rename existing ids.

writesUnder.description: Where this skill writes artifacts. Feature-path skills use agent-engineer-skills/<feature-name>/. Omit or vary if this skill does not write there.
